notes: The compiler's father opens the chain as a bare relation («أبي رضي الله عنه»).
«عمن حدثه من أصحابنا» is an unnamed link (rule 8). The Imam Abu Abd Allah inside the chain stays a narrator.

Ali is named only in the words after the chain («قال أمير المؤمنين عليه السلام»), so he is the last link, kind imam_in_text (owner ruling 2). «سمعته يقول» points back to Abu Abd Allah: no new name (rule 5).
